scope: Proposition 6.4 (One compression stage) of the manuscript “The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t)” (preprints/The-Sharp-Logarithmic-Exponent-of-r-5-t-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 170 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 71adbadd9abac57b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose a selected consistent tuple and context satisfy (5)–(7), with deterministic ℓ = Θ(k) and bounded stream-marginal density, and suppose the rectangle- occupancy event of Lemma 3.3 holds almost surely. Then either the high-rank argument contradicts Lemma 3.4, or a constant-probability extraction produces another such tuple, of deterministic length Θ(k), and a new context satisfying (26), where w ≤ Cσ1+η/2 /D. (27) Its decoder is independent of the old context.
